# `dateadd`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
dateadd(start_date, num_days)
```

Returns the date that is `num_days` after `start_date`.

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `datetime_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 3.4.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 2 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- dateadd, example 1
> SELECT dateadd('2016-07-30', 1);
2016-07-31
```
